title: P3 Native Learning & Research Backlog
completion_authority: Task state is implementation scheduling/evidence only. Masterplan maturity and independent sign-off remain separate authorities.

tasks.title: Data, lineage and dataset foundation
tasks.objective: Make data ingestion, lineage, quality, datasets, synthetic data, caching, content addressing, and transaction semantics executable and provenance-bound for native learning.
acceptance: Inherited masterplan obligations remain exact and may only be strengthened, never narrowed.
Executable local/provider-independent evidence is required before landed_unpromoted.
Failure, cancellation, checkpoint/recovery, provenance and negative-path behavior must be exercised where applicable.
No task may self-promote masterplan maturity or independent sign-off.

masterplan_obligations.title: Distributed Transaction Strategy
requirements: Choose atomic transaction, saga or reconciliation model per operation.
Persist compensation/recovery state before external effects where required.

masterplan_obligations.title: Cache Architecture
requirements: Never let cache contents become sole authoritative state.
Bind cache keys to tenant/version/trust context and define stale behavior.

masterplan_obligations.title: Content Addressing
requirements: Canonicalize bytes before digest where a format requires it.
Support digest migration without confusing logical identity.

masterplan_obligations.title: Data Ingestion Engine
requirements: Preserve source identity, acquisition time, rights/classification and parser version.
Quarantine malformed/untrusted inputs before downstream indexing.

masterplan_obligations.title: Document Intelligence
requirements: Preserve page/region coordinates and extraction method for every derived claim.
Separate OCR/vision uncertainty from source text.

masterplan_obligations.title: Data Lineage
requirements: Record transformation identity, inputs, outputs and environment/version.
Propagate deletion, classification and trust constraints through derived data.

masterplan_obligations.title: Data Quality Engine
requirements: Define quality checks per dataset/use case and retain raw measurements.
Block promotion when critical quality failures violate declared thresholds.

masterplan_obligations.title: Dataset Registry
requirements: Give every dataset/split immutable identity and provenance.
Track permitted use, retention, PII and benchmark contamination.

masterplan_obligations.title: Synthetic Data Factory
requirements: Label synthetic origin and generator configuration permanently.
Measure diversity, validity, bias and leakage against real/reference data.

tasks.title: Native training control and recovery
tasks.objective: Materialize a provider-independent training control plane with distributed execution, checkpoint/recovery, observability, evaluation gates, post-training, curricula, RL environments, and verifier-model custody.
acceptance: Inherited masterplan obligations remain exact and may only be strengthened, never narrowed.
Executable local/provider-independent evidence is required before landed_unpromoted.
Failure, cancellation, checkpoint/recovery, provenance and negative-path behavior must be exercised where applicable.
No task may self-promote masterplan maturity or independent sign-off.

masterplan_obligations.title: Training Control Plane
requirements: Require registered inputs and explicit resource/budget admission.
Persist run state/checkpoints/evidence independently of worker lifetime.

masterplan_obligations.title: Distributed Training
requirements: Define data/model parallel topology and collective timeouts explicitly.
Handle worker loss/stragglers without corrupting optimizer/model state.

masterplan_obligations.title: Training Checkpointing
requirements: Checkpoint all state required for semantically equivalent resume.
Verify digest and compatibility before restore.

masterplan_obligations.title: Elastic Training Recovery
requirements: Record consumed data position and optimizer semantics across membership changes.
Use fencing/epoch identity to reject stale workers.

masterplan_obligations.title: Training Observability
requirements: Capture enough telemetry to diagnose divergence without leaking restricted data.
Alert on non-finite values, stalls, throughput collapse and resource anomalies.

masterplan_obligations.title: Training Evaluation Gates
requirements: Evaluate candidates before registry promotion using fixed/versioned suites.
Require explicit disposition for regressions and uncertainty.

masterplan_obligations.title: Post-Training Lab
requirements: Separate experimental post-training from production model authority.
Record data, objective, algorithm and evaluation lineage for every candidate.

masterplan_obligations.title: Reinforcement Learning Environments
requirements: Keep environment side effects sandboxed and reproducible.
Version reward logic and detect exploitation/specification gaming.

masterplan_obligations.title: Curriculum Engine
requirements: Represent curriculum transitions and prerequisites explicitly.
Prevent easy-task cycling or metric gaming from starving required competencies.

masterplan_obligations.title: Verifier Model Program
requirements: Keep verifier authority separate from generator confidence.
Measure calibration, false accept/reject and shared-bias failure modes.

tasks.title: Multimodal ingestion and retrieval
tasks.objective: Create typed local multimodal ingestion, vision/document/audio/video surfaces and retrieval contracts without hosted-provider dependence.
acceptance: Inherited masterplan obligations remain exact and may only be strengthened, never narrowed.
Executable local/provider-independent evidence is required before landed_unpromoted.
Failure, cancellation, checkpoint/recovery, provenance and negative-path behavior must be exercised where applicable.
No task may self-promote masterplan maturity or independent sign-off.

masterplan_obligations.title: Multimodal Ingestion Core
requirements: Preserve source bytes/digests, metadata classification and transformation lineage.
Apply resource limits and trust labels before decoding.

masterplan_obligations.title: Vision Pipeline
requirements: Validate dimensions/format/resources before decode/inference.
Preserve crop/region transforms so outputs can trace to source pixels.

masterplan_obligations.title: Document Vision
requirements: Keep OCR text linked to page coordinates and confidence.
Detect conflicting OCR/text-layer evidence rather than silently choosing one.

masterplan_obligations.title: Audio Pipeline
requirements: Preserve sample rate/channel/time offsets across transformations.
Separate speech/music/event outputs with confidence and model identity.

masterplan_obligations.title: Live Speech Runtime
requirements: Distinguish provisional transcripts from authoritative final segments.
Handle barge-in, reconnect, cancellation and timing backpressure explicitly.

masterplan_obligations.title: Video Pipeline
requirements: Bound decode/frame sampling workloads before processing.
Preserve timestamps and source offsets across sampled frames/clips.

masterplan_obligations.title: Multimodal Retrieval
requirements: Normalize cross-modal evidence into comparable provenance-bearing results.
Apply tenant, time, classification and trust filters before ranking.

tasks.title: Research, evidence and causal science
tasks.objective: Materialize artifact review, research teams, literature/citation evidence, reproducibility, experiment comparison, statistics, hypotheses and causal knowledge with provenance and conflict handling.
acceptance: Inherited masterplan obligations remain exact and may only be strengthened, never narrowed.
Executable local/provider-independent evidence is required before landed_unpromoted.
Failure, cancellation, checkpoint/recovery, provenance and negative-path behavior must be exercised where applicable.
No task may self-promote masterplan maturity or independent sign-off.

masterplan_obligations.title: Artifact Review Workflow
requirements: Preserve artifact version under review and review lineage.
Block publication/promotion until required reviewers/gates resolve.

masterplan_obligations.title: Research Agent Team
requirements: Assign distinct research roles and evidence ownership.
Require handoffs preserve source/method/uncertainty lineage.

masterplan_obligations.title: Literature Watch System
requirements: Track publication/version/retraction/correction identity.
Do not auto-promote novel claims into architecture without evaluation.

masterplan_obligations.title: Citation Graph Analytics
requirements: Represent citations, claims, replication and contradiction separately.
Preserve temporal/source-version context.

masterplan_obligations.title: Reproduction Packages
requirements: Bind package to exact claim/result and artifact digests.
Represent unavailable/restricted dependencies explicitly.

masterplan_obligations.title: Experiment Comparison
requirements: Reject comparisons with material uncontrolled differences unless explicitly qualified.
Preserve raw run evidence behind summaries.

masterplan_obligations.title: Statistical Analysis
requirements: Declare population/sample/metric assumptions and missing-data handling.
Report effect size and uncertainty, not only p-values.

masterplan_obligations.title: Hypothesis Engine
requirements: Preserve competing hypotheses until evidence resolves them.
Separate hypothesis plausibility from verified fact.

masterplan_obligations.title: Causal Knowledge
requirements: Every causal edge records evidence/method/assumptions.
Interventions/simulations cannot be reported as observed facts.

tasks.title: Model and agent evaluation system
tasks.objective: Build model/agent evaluation, long-horizon benchmarks, contamination controls, human evaluation and evidence-backed model/dataset/tool/agent cards.
acceptance: Inherited masterplan obligations remain exact and may only be strengthened, never narrowed.
Executable local/provider-independent evidence is required before landed_unpromoted.
Failure, cancellation, checkpoint/recovery, provenance and negative-path behavior must be exercised where applicable.
No task may self-promote masterplan maturity or independent sign-off.

masterplan_obligations.title: Model Evaluation Harness
requirements: Freeze evaluation spec/environment before comparative runs.
Capture outputs/scores/errors and model/inference identity.

masterplan_obligations.title: Agent Evaluation Harness
requirements: Score end-to-end task outcome and policy adherence separately.
Capture action traces/receipts for failure attribution.

masterplan_obligations.title: Long-Horizon Benchmarks
requirements: Benchmarks must include restart/checkpoint and stale-world conditions.
Measure cumulative error, intervention and resource use over horizon.

masterplan_obligations.title: Contamination Auditor
requirements: Fingerprint exact and near-duplicate content across datasets.
Record contamination confidence and disposition per benchmark/model.

masterplan_obligations.title: Human Evaluation
requirements: Protect rater privacy and separate identity from public results.
Measure inter-rater reliability and adjudicate high-impact disagreement.
gaps: bind human evidence to quality vector

masterplan_obligations.title: Model Card System
requirements: Cards reference immutable model/eval versions.
Separate measured facts from qualitative claims.

masterplan_obligations.title: Dataset Card System
requirements: Cards bind to immutable dataset version/fingerprint.
Document excluded/unknown provenance and sensitive attributes.

masterplan_obligations.title: Tool Card System
requirements: Cards cannot grant authority; they document governed contracts.
Bind to exact tool version/implementation owner.

masterplan_obligations.title: Agent Card System
requirements: Bind card to agent definition/version and evaluation evidence.
Clearly distinguish default authority from optional delegated grants.

tasks.title: Local model serving efficiency
tasks.objective: Add local memory-aware serving controls, model eviction, KV/prefix caching, and speculative inference with deterministic identity and bounded fallback.
acceptance: Inherited masterplan obligations remain exact and may only be strengthened, never narrowed.
Executable local/provider-independent evidence is required before landed_unpromoted.
Failure, cancellation, checkpoint/recovery, provenance and negative-path behavior must be exercised where applicable.
No task may self-promote masterplan maturity or independent sign-off.

masterplan_obligations.title: GPU Memory Manager
requirements: Admission reserves memory before load/request batch.
Manager handles fragmentation and concurrent reservations deterministically.

masterplan_obligations.title: Model Eviction
requirements: Eviction excludes pinned/in-flight models until safe boundary.
Eviction decisions are observable and reversible by reload.

masterplan_obligations.title: KV Cache Service
requirements: Cache entries bind to exact model/config/token prefix/session context.
Never reuse across incompatible privacy/tenant/model boundaries.

masterplan_obligations.title: Prefix Cache
requirements: Prefix cache key includes instruction/prompt/model/tokenizer/version.
Sensitive prefixes are not shared beyond authorized scope.

masterplan_obligations.title: Speculative Inference
requirements: Verify draft tokens against target model before acceptance.
Track quality/latency/cost and fallback to normal decoding.

tasks.objective: Create bounded build/evaluation/research compute queues with ownership, admission, cancellation, fairness, and durable evidence.

masterplan_obligations.title: Build Farm
requirements: Jobs run from immutable source/build inputs.
Outputs/logs/attestations bind to job and worker identity.

masterplan_obligations.title: Evaluation Farm
requirements: Distribute evaluation jobs from immutable eval/model/dataset specs.
Results bind to worker/environment/scorer identity and aggregate deterministically.

masterplan_obligations.title: Research Compute Queue
requirements: Queue experiments/reproductions/research workloads with priority, quota and provenance.
Research jobs cannot preempt critical production work outside declared policy.
